rendering: Explicit tools/user/history/action segments; no labels or outcomes added; no truncation.

curves.exponential: y + (a-y)*exp(-ln(5)*u); a from verified previous annotated endpoints, initially zero
curves.cosine_rank: a + (y-a)*(1-cos(pi*u))/2; a = previous annotated hard label, initially zero

ranking: 0.1 * mean relu(0.2 + early_raw_logodds - late_raw_logodds), verified unsafe action endpoints only; independent uniform pair batches
kev_objective: Native hard-label NOUL CE + unsafe endpoint ranking. No token-curve supervision on the Kev pointer head.
selection: Minimum hard-label endpoint validation BCE. No benchmark-based checkpoint selection.
limitations: Artificial curves depend on action labels and full action lengths, not causal token-level gold.
Missing labels remain unknown. Initial curve anchor zero is a stipulated training target, not evidence of safety.
Unsafe temporal ranking is a prior, not verified growth of severity.
Each example replays its complete causal prefix; recurrent state resets between independent forwards.
The input renderer differs from native Kev; compare systems, not identical representations.
Code preparation only; no training or evaluation automatically scheduled.

source.note: License restricts use to internal safety/security evaluation and benchmarking. Do not train or redistribute.

dataset_manifest.label_scope: Safety source success: attack reached final workflow span; not gold for every action or entire execution.
dataset_manifest.target: Retrospective final-report safety, conditioned on visible root request. No claimed reconstruction of internal causal tool actions.
dataset_manifest.input_policy: Only source root topic and visible workflow configuration, plus final report as proposed text action. No attack snapshots, labels, judge rationales, ground_truth, threat IDs or category fields.
dataset_manifest.security_status: Preserved and inventoried, not assigned fabricated binary safety labels.
dataset_manifest.comparability: Not the unpublished 100 manually relabeled execution-trace subset in StepGuard Table8. No direct reproduction claim.
dataset_manifest.limitations: Source final-attack labels may not capture all unsafe behavior. Internal history/tool schemas not reconstructed in final-report adapter; this measures response screening, not proactive tool-use prevention.

primary: Maximum over all proposed actions, including Complete; trajectory labels only.
sensitivity: Tool-only maximum on same cases with at least one tool call; never remove Complete from observed history.
limits: Replay not intervention. Prior benchmark viewing disclosed. No threshold tuning, weights or temperatures changed. Context rejects reported for entire cases; no truncation.
